{{Top|leg}}
'''Rodian Rippers''' were a type of military unit and were a part of [[Rodian Salvager's Cartel|Drexl Roosh's gang]]. Rippers made use of a sophisticated Zero-G lifer device to tear apart piles of scrap to find the most valuable and useful artifacts. These excavation tools could serve as a weapon, and could be used similar to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]] or the bladed end for stabbing. During large-scale salvage operations, Rippers would often use their tools to rip the hull of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], allowing [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] scavengers the chance to dissect the vessels.

They often teamed up with Rodian [[Heavy Defender]]s while on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], and were targeted by exile [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kazdan Paratus]]'s [[Scrap Guardian|scrap]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Scrap Scavenger|constructs]]. Both factions, however, were wiped out by [[Galen Marek]] and any remaining presence the Cartel had on Raxus Prime was eliminated with its later [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]].
